title: Reagan-era release of Falcon and Condor in UFO Cover-Up Live

tellings.quote: the story was Reagan allowed the the whole thing about the Falcon and the Condor to come out and the alien at Wright Patterson Air Force Base.

plain: President Ronald Reagan is said to have allowed the claims of two hidden insiders, called Falcon and Condor, to come out, including talk of an alien kept at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells this without naming his source, and the claims aired on UFO Cover-Up Live, a television special broadcast in 1988 in which the two men spoke with their faces and voices disguised. If true, the broadcast would have been a release approved at the very top rather than a leak.
